meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 11 — Multi-domain densification from parallel research rounds: defence budget & posture, education (including tertiary GER), construction, rice/paddy & food-security core, sea transportation, gender statistics, and related supporting nodes.

candidates.title: Defence budget and military expenditure statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Defence / Ministry of Finance / international compilations citing official figures
candidates.description: Official and widely cited defence budget allocations (recent figures rising toward Rp 187 trillion in 2026) and broader military-expenditure estimates. Defence burden remains relatively low as a share of GDP for an archipelagic state with extensive maritime interests.
candidates.notes: Core defence-resource node. Links fiscal capacity to the maritime-strategic layer.

candidates.title: Defence and security policy framing (archipelagic posture)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Defence / related strategic documents
candidates.description: Recurring policy and strategic framing of Indonesia’s defence posture as an archipelagic state, including modernisation programmes and the linkage between territorial integrity, sea lanes and external security.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame node that connects the defence cluster to the strategic-geography layer.

candidates.title: Statistics of Education
candidates.description: Annual BPS education statistics covering process and outcome indicators from Susenas and administrative school data (schools, classrooms, teachers, sanitation). National and provincial presentation.
referenced_by: Welfare Indicators and RPJMN human-development targets

candidates.title: Gross Enrolment Ratio in tertiary education by province
candidates.description: Provincial GER for tertiary education (age 19–23). Shows extreme variation — Yogyakarta far above the national average, eastern provinces much lower — reinforcing the spatial human-capital gradient.
candidates.notes: High-visibility spatial education node (Yogyakarta outlier is especially notable).

candidates.title: Construction in Figures / construction sector statistics
candidates.description: Annual compilation of construction-sector data: workers, wages, construction value, materials, indices, construction GRDP, Construction Cost Index, etc. Provincial tables included.

candidates.title: Paddy and rice production statistics by province
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Area Sampling Frame & crop-cutting surveys)
candidates.description: Official harvested-area and production statistics for paddy (GKG) and rice. Java (especially East, West and Central) dominates production; the series is central to food-security and inflation analysis.
candidates.notes: Foundational food-security production node. Strong Java concentration.

candidates.title: Sea Transportation Statistics
candidates.description: Annual statistics on ship calls, cargo loading/unloading, and passenger embarkation/disembarkation for domestic and international voyages at Indonesian seaports. Direct empirical counterpart to the inter-island and chokepoint layers.
candidates.notes: Operational maritime-transport node that quantifies the domestic and international shipping activity through Indonesian ports.

candidates.title: Domestic multimodal transport statistics (sea, air, rail, river/ferry)
candidates.description: High-frequency and annual statistics on passenger and goods movement by sea, air, rail and river/lake/ferry modes. Captures the multi-modal character of mobility across the archipelago.
candidates.notes: Broader mobility densification around the sea-transport core.

candidates.title: Women and Men in Indonesia
candidates.description: Annual gender-statistics compendium covering population, employment, health, education, housing, ICT and household socio-economic status for women and men.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index of 38 Provinces
candidates.description: Provincial CPI series (current base 2022=100) that reveal price-level and inflation differentials across the archipelago. Complements the national CPI and feeds analysis of inter-island price disparities.
candidates.notes: Spatial price node that makes archipelagic price diversity statistically visible.

candidates.title: Indonesia defence–education–construction–food–transport–gender densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from BPS, Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Finance and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding defence budget and archipelagic posture, education statistics and tertiary GER, construction sector statistics, paddy/rice production, sea and multimodal transport, gender statistics, and provincial CPI into a coherent multi-domain densification layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier fiscal, agricultural, maritime, provincial and social series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the multi-domain research rounds in Batch 11.
